name: Biology: Measured tandem-spectrum peptide reconstruction
description: Decode physically mass-consistent peptide sequences from measured fragment spectra and rank confidence under exact-sequence and precision-coverage evaluation.

sources.locator: Casanovo Methods: de novo sequencing, precursor constraints and precision/coverage evaluation.
Official author implementation/data reference; evaluator and seed are independently written, not copied.

requirements.datasets: Pinned source-derived bundle B12.json plus SHA256 manifest under .cache/science-biology; prepare using scripts/prepare_biology_expansion.py. Automatic compact-source staging available.

evaluation.paper_metric: Local protocol; see candidate contract and source adaptation notes

execution.interface: decode_spectrum(peaks, precursor_mass, charge) -> (unmodified_peptide, confidence0..1). precursor_mass is NEUTRAL mass in Da (not m/z). Standard residues, I/L equivalent, mass error<=50ppm. Empty sequence/confidence0 is abstention. Maximize tie-grouped stepwise precision-coverage area; exact recall diagnostic. Measured-spectrum CPU decoder track, no learned encoder required.

provenance.note: New local evaluator and seed based on cited source specifications; official data are reused.

limitations: Classical CPU decoder adaptation of twelve unique unmodified peptides in the official measured mouse sample. Not full nine-species/generalization benchmark or learned-encoder reproduction; I/L are equivalent and precursor mass is neutralDa.
Public source subsets are development-visible. Freeze candidates before evaluating on additional independently chosen studies/instances; trusted candidate execution is not a security sandbox.
Improving this benchmark is a scientific-method result; it does not alone establish a new biological discovery.

science_relevance.scientific_problem: Determine peptide amino-acid sequences from tandem mass spectra without requiring a matching sequence database.
science_relevance.importance_rationale: De novo peptide sequencing supports protein characterization, including sequences absent from reference databases.

papers.title: Sequence-to-sequence translation from mass spectra to peptides with a transformer model
papers.primary_goal: Reconstruct peptide sequences directly from measured tandem mass spectra.
papers.task_relation: The local task retains measured MS/MS sequence reconstruction, precursor-mass consistency and confidence evaluation. Its selected spectra and scoring are not a full Casanovo reproduction or validation of newly discovered proteins.
